Limited Access Highways, Scenic Highways and Virginia Byways, and Highways Over Dams

law.catch_line: Business enterprises restricted on limited access highway right-of-way
law.text: No commercial establishment or business enterprise shall be constructed or located upon any right-of-way of any limited access highway.
